profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software Engineer based in Homedale, Idaho with 10+ years of experience building ecommerce storefronts, custom web applications, and polished user interfaces. I specialize in Shopify, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Liquid, React, NextJS, and modern frontend tooling.

In recent roles, I’ve led development on Shopify storefronts, subscription workflows, 3rd party integrations, and client-facing web projects while helping lead a small team of developers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Internet Software · Web Development · Content Management Systems (CMS) · Landing Page Optimization · Landing Pages · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · Conversion Optimization

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Built and scaled Shopify and ecommerce storefronts for client brands, with ownership across storefront architecture, theme development, subscription commerce, analytics, and third-party integrations. 

Developed custom Shopify Online Store experiences using Liquid, JavaScript/TypeScript, Vue, Tailwind CSS, and modern frontend tooling. 

Implemented and maintained complex commerce workflows across PDPs, carts, subscriptions, upsells, account experiences, Shopify Plus checkout extensions, metafields, metaobjects, and customer/order data pipelines. 

Integrated platforms including Recharge, Segment, GA4, Littledata, HubSpot, Klaviyo, Rivo, Gorgias, Intelligems, and Shopify Flow. 

Progressed from Software Engineer to Senior Software Engineer, leading a small team of developers while taking on greater responsibility for technical planning, client communication, QA, code review, mentorship, and delivery of client-facing ecommerce projects.

positions.title: Freelance Software Engineer
positions.description: Built and deployed a membership web app, complete with a member portal allowing users to create posts and pay dues. Creating this from the ground up with ReactJS and Firebase allowed me to keep clients overhead low.

positions.title: Media - Technical Director - Camera Operator
positions.description:
Operate switchboard and/or cameras on location for live broadcast events syndicating to 1M+ unique viewers.

Actively manage the Revvolution.com external social channels including Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, Flickr, etc.while strategically syndicating Revvolution content through these channels.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Trusted to build and maintain fully functioning prototypes and web apps for different clients based on their vision and the desired end result. Using tools like Wordpress, Bubble.io, Glide Apps, Google App Scripts, and Shopify, required me to find creative ways around technical limitations to deliver the requested features.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Responsible for developing, maintaining, and supporting Media Portal, the customer facing CDN Portal. 
- Created pixel-perfect user interfaces by working closely with UI/UX designers, reviewing wireframes, and individual intuition.
-Collaborated closely with scrum master, peer developers, QA, and product owners to keep projects on track, meet anticipated deadlines, and deliver stable, high quality code.

positions.title: Ranger Tech Services - Chief Student Technician
positions.description: Provide technical support to students. Install new software updates, remove viruses, and troubleshoot problems.

positions.title: Enterprise Automation & Integration - Corporate SOA Integration INROADS Intern.
positions.description:
- Created and designed a Sharepoint form from the ground up to organize and manage ongoing projects within the SOA team. 
- Recognized by supervisor for eagerness to learn new technical skills and to have a keen problem solving mind.

positions.title: Global IT Asset Management INROADS Intern
positions.description:
- Created and analyzed reports for IT assets. Received complements from supervisors for the quickness, efficiency, and accuracy of the reports.
- Received input from around the world from First Data locations and normalized the data, then either prepared the data for batch upload or entered the data manually.
